name: excalidraw
description: Read, create, and edit Excalidraw (.excalidraw) diagrams programmatically — parse and summarize a drawing, generate schema-valid diagrams and flowcharts, add/move/restyle/connect shapes with correctly bound arrows and labels, convert simple Mermaid to Excalidraw, and validate the result. Keeps element identity randomized, bindings bidirectional, and points relative. Not for rasterizing PNG/SVG in-process or the excalidraw.com web UI.
